title: FBI-UAP-D005, FD-1057-04, Northeastern United States, 2024
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-1057 interview record regarding multiple UAP sightings reported by a single witness in the northeastern United States.

incidents.summary: Witness observed lights outside their home that split into a triangular pattern.
behavior: split into two or three lights
incidents.quote: observed a singular light that eventually split into two or three lights

incidents.summary: Sighting of a UAP at a different location than the witness's primary residence.
incidents.quote: the light observed appears to morph and move laterally

incidents.summary: Vehicle shutdown and light encounter while driving in New Mexico.
incidents.quote: the vehicle was driving shut down and a large light shined on

incidents.summary: Witness reports seeing hundreds of lights from their property since 2021.
incidents.quote: has seen hundreds of these lights from property
